title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: M4 HAS TWO COMMITS, NEITHER SHIPPABLE YET, NOTHING PUSHED, NO PR. All four ship-gate findings are AUDITED and RECONCILED; two drafted remedies were REFUTED as wrong-surface and a fifth finding was found by mutation. Rulings locked as 0203/0204/0205 and the amend-and-rebase is USER-AUTHORIZED. Remaining: execute the sequence in a fresh session, re-verify per commit, then ship the two stacked PRs.
spine.next_step: START HERE IN A FRESH SESSION with a full context window. The user AUTHORIZED the amend-and-rebase 2026-08-02. Execute 0203/0204/0205; reconciliation is the 07-28 entry, close is the 07-35 entry (read per 0202). ORDER: amend 777617b (F3 validator + corrected message), then three atomic commits (F1 e2e test, F4 clamp cleanup, F2 coverage file), then rebase feat/m4-divergence-instrumentation and add the 0205 assertions plus its OWN coverage file. Re-verify per commit BEFORE any push.
open_risks: F1 RESOLVED: the foreign-branch gap is CONFIRMED LIVE by mutation -- a foreign PR becomes a unit's merge target and freezes its real work. Remedy is an e2e test next to M2b. classifyRunOpenPRs has NO twin, so e2e is the lowest layer that can express it.

F2 RESOLVED: TWO coverage files are MANDATORY, one per branch. A file added on commit 1 yields ZERO diff lines for PR 2 because linear history makes merge-base equal the base. The gate is PR-diff-scoped, which corrects 0201's per-commit rationale.

F3 RESOLVED: buildAheadCap 9999 is silently ACCEPTED and widens the frontier unbounded -- the cap was never fixed. 0203 bounds it 1..8 and halts otherwise. The drafted one-line null fix was REFUTED as the wrong surface.

F4 RESOLVED: manifest.window is read nowhere; the premise holds. But the blast radius is ~25 in-file calls plus a DUPLICATE helper in reconcile-only-advance-characterization.test.mjs -- the wide cleanup is a follow-up, not M4.

FIFTH FINDING, mutation-proven by F2: invalidatingParents has ZERO acceptance coverage -- `if (false)` at reconcile.mjs:115 leaves reconcile.test.mjs at 23/23 green. 0205 adds assertions to the four real-invalidation tests.

THE AMEND-AND-REBASE IS USER-AUTHORIZED (2026-08-02) for the 0204 sequence ONLY; a deviation must be re-confirmed. F2 measured it clean: no conflicts, 1830/1830 on both commits, mirror-guard 46/46, gate green per commit against its real base.

UNVERIFIED POINTER, CHECK EARLY: a background task titled 'Fix dead pre-commit hook chain in this repo' was seen and deleted. If the chain IS dead, this thread's 'npm test + pre-commit hook' double-run claim is really ONE run. Verify before trusting commit-time verification.
0203 RESIDUAL KNOWINGLY ACCEPTED: an out-of-repo caller passing buildAheadCap null to mean 'no override' would now HALT. F3 could not measure callers outside this repo.

'REQUIRED' IS SOFTER THAN THIS THREAD ASSUMED: no branch protection on main, one ruleset (Require PR for Merge, 19939922) carrying NO required_status_checks. CI red does not physically block the merge button today.
1830 IS CONFIRMED independently on BOTH commits in clean throwaway worktrees. 1839 is main-worktree inflation from a gitignored file. Never quote 1839 as a CI expectation.

F2's DRAFTED 12-ROW CONTENT for both coverage files is grounded but UNWRITTEN, and the commits change under 0204 -- re-check each verdict against the FINAL commit contents rather than pasting the draft.

BARE-INVOCATION ERGONOMICS is a real, RECURRING defect -- two documented incidents. A local run with no env vars silently takes push mode and reports green. OUT OF M4 SCOPE; its own follow-up against the checker script.

FIX-ROUND DISCIPLINE (standing; five prior rounds each introduced a new defect on an unnamed path): plan against INVARIANTS, never a finding list. This round vindicated it -- two of four drafted remedies were the wrong surface.

PR scope is FROZEN at creation; later facts go in a comment (0142). pr-create is the ONLY PR path, requires --provenance with --origin machine, rejects angle brackets in --what, caps free text at 200 chars. MERGE STAYS HUMAN-GATED for both PRs.

STACK SHAPE per decision A AS AMENDED BY 0204: PR 1 = feat/m4-fixed-build-ahead-cap -> main, no longer '777617b alone'; PR 2 = feat/m4-divergence-instrumentation -> that branch. Independent PRs off main stay REJECTED.

CI ORDERING RULE: read CI on both head SHAs BEFORE opening either PR. Bodies freeze at creation, so opening first would lock in a not-run verification line. Also run mitosis-gate.mjs phase-parity and the sandbox-compile gate (95ef8e1).

LEDGER READ PATH per 0202: spine and all WRITES via MCP, but session entries and decision records ONLY via `git show _ledger:<path>`. session-continuity-inline is LIVE. 0199 is a VOID probe artifact, never link it.

Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
